# Game Idea: Canvas Dodger

- **Genre**: Endless runner on HTML canvas.
- **Core mechanic**: A sprite automatically moves forward; player taps/clicks to make it jump over procedurally generated obstacles.
- **Lose condition**: Collision with an obstacle ends the game.
- **Visuals**: Simple 2‑D pixel art, parallax background.
- **Scoring**: Distance traveled.

1: // Simple endless runner for canvas with id="game"
2: // Player jumps on click/tap, avoids incoming obstacles. Enhanced graphics with gradient background, ground, simple player sprite, clouds, and colored obstacles.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
10: 
11:   // Audio setup
12:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
13:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
14:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     osc.type = 'sine';
17:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
18:     osc.connect(gain);
19:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
21:     osc.start();
22:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:   }
24: 
25:   // Background layers (parallax clouds)
26:   const clouds = [];
27:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
28:     clouds.push({
29:       x: Math.random() * width,
30:       y: 20 + Math.random() * 60,
31:       radius: 20 + Math.random() * 30,
32:       speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
33:     });
34:   }
35:   function drawBackground() {
36:     // Sky gradient
37:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
38:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light blue
39:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#fff');
40:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
41:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
42:     // Clouds
43:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
44:     for (const c of clouds) {
45:       ctx.beginPath();
46:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
47:       ctx.fill();
48:       c.x -= c.speed;
49:       if (c.x + c.radius < 0) {
50:         c.x = width + c.radius;
51:         c.y = 20 + Math.random() * 60;
52:         c.radius = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
53:       }
54:     }
55:     // Ground
56:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
57:     ctx.fillRect(0, height - 30, width, 30);
58:   }
59: 
60:   // Player
61:   const player = {
62:     x: 50,
63:     y: height - 60,
64:     width: 30,
65:     height: 30,
66:     vy: 0,
67:     jumpStrength: -12,
68:     gravity: 0.5,
69:     onGround: true,
70:     draw() {
71:       // simple sprite: orange body with white eye
72:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8800';
73:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
74:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
75:       ctx.beginPath();
76:       ctx.arc(this.x + this.width * 0.7, this.y + this.height * 0.3, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
77:       ctx.fill();
78:     },
79:     update() {
80:       this.vy += this.gravity;
81:       this.y += this.vy;
82:       const groundY = height - 30 - this.height; // ground height 30
83:       if (this.y >= groundY) {
84:         this.y = groundY;
85:         this.vy = 0;
86:         this.onGround = true;
87:       } else {
88:         this.onGround = false;
89:       }
90:     },
91:     jump() {
92:       if (this.onGround) {
93:         this.vy = this.jumpStrength;
94:         this.onGround = false;
95:       }
96:     },
97:   };
98: 
99:   // Obstacles
100:   const obstacles = [];
101:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
102:   const obstacleInterval = 90; // frames
103: 
104:   function spawnObstacle() {
105:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
106:     obstacles.push({
107:       x: width,
108:       y: height - 30 - size, // sit on ground
109:       width: size,
110:       height: size,
111:       speed: 4 + Math.random() * 2,
112:       color: `hsl(${Math.random() * 360}, 50%, 40%)`,
113:     });
114:   }
115: 
116:   function updateObstacles() {
117:     obstacleTimer++;
118:     if (obstacleTimer > obstacleInterval) {
119:       spawnObstacle();
120:       obstacleTimer = 0;
121:     }
122:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
123:       const o = obstacles[i];
124:       o.x -= o.speed;
125:       if (o.x + o.width < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function drawObstacles() {
130:     for (const o of obstacles) {
131:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
132:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.width, o.height);
133:     }
134:   }
135: 
136:   function checkCollision() {
137:     for (const o of obstacles) {
138:       if (
139:         player.x < o.x + o.width &&
140:         player.x + player.width > o.x &&
141:         player.y < o.y + o.height &&
142:         player.y + player.height > o.y
143:       ) {
144:         // Game over overlay
145:         cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
146:         // play collision sound
147:         playBeep(150, 0.4);
148:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
149:         ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
150:         ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
151:         ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
152:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 80, height / 2);
153:         return true;
154:       }
155:     }
156:     return false;
157:   }
158: 
159:   // Input
160:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
161:     audioCtx.resume(); // ensure context is running
162:     player.jump();
163:     playBeep(300, 0.1); // jump sound
164:   });
165:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
166:     e.preventDefault();
167:     audioCtx.resume();
168:     player.jump();
169:     playBeep(300, 0.1);
170:   }, { passive: false });
171: 
172:   // Audio setup
173:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
174:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
175:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
176:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
177:     osc.type = 'sine';
178:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
179:     osc.connect(gain);
180:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
181:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
182:     osc.start();
183:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
184:   }
185: 
186:   // Score
187:   let score = 0;
188:   function drawScore() {
189:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
190:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
191:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
192:   }
193: 
194:   // Main loop
195:   let frameId;
196:   function loop() {
197:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
198:     drawBackground();
199:     player.update();
200:     updateObstacles();
201:     player.draw();
202:     drawObstacles();
203:     drawScore();
204:     if (!checkCollision()) {
205:       score += 0.1;
206:       frameId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
207:     }
208:   }
209: 
210:   loop();
211: })();

(End of file - total 211 lines)
</content>
